# Nourish By Ekta

> Online clinical nutrition practice run by Dietitian Ekta Matlani (M.Sc Applied Nutrition, ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition). Specialises in gut health and hormonal/metabolic conditions. Consultations are by video call and WhatsApp for clients anywhere in India.

## Practitioner
- Name: Dt. Ekta Matlani
- Education: M.Sc Applied Nutrition, ICMR-NIN (All India Rank 11, NCET 2021)
- Certifications: Monash University Low FODMAP Diet for IBS; Certified Diabetes Educator (International Diabetes Federation)
- Research: "Oral Nitrate Reducing Activity in Hypertension", ICMR-NIN

## Conditions treated
IBS, bloating and gas, SIBO, IBD, acid reflux / GERD, gastritis, constipation, celiac disease, food intolerance and food allergy, PCOS / PCOD, thyroid, fatty liver (NAFLD), diabetes and pre-diabetes, weight management.

## Programs and fees (INR)
- Discovery call: free, 15 minutes, to check fit and recommend a program (no diet plan given on this call)
- 1 Month Nutrition Program: ₹4,000 — diet assessment, customised meal plan, 4 weekly 30-min video calls, WhatsApp support
- 3 Month Nutrition Program: ₹10,000 — 12 weekly video calls, monthly meal plans, lab report interpretation, supplement guidance, priority WhatsApp support

## Approach
Evidence-based, whole-food, Indian-diet-friendly plans personalised to diagnosis, lab reports and lifestyle. No crash diets. Low FODMAP elimination and reintroduction for IBS.
